title: pandas-dev/pandas CodeQL autobuild cannot build the C extension

ground_truth.fix_summary: Replace the codeql-action/autobuild step for the c-cpp language with explicit build steps that install the project build requirements, or switch that language to build-mode none.

provenance.notes: Labelled pipeline_config because the fix belongs in the workflow, not in the repository source: the action itself says 'We were unable to automatically build your code. Please replace the call to the autobuild action with your custom build steps.' The proximate error is '../meson.build:7:13: ERROR: Command `/usr/bin/python3 generate_version.py --print` failed with status 1.', which is the autobuild guess of a build command running under the system interpreter without the project build requirements. related_to_diff is false: the event is a scheduled run on main and the captured diff only rewrites LaTeX escapes in a docstring in pandas/core/generic.py, which cannot affect a meson configure step. culprit_files uses the workflow path the log itself reports as CODEQL_ACTION_ANALYSIS_KEY. Caveat on the taxonomy: none of the pipeline_config subcategories describes a misconfigured build step, and action_version was chosen as the nearest fit. Blind adjudication: both labellers agreed on pipeline_config and both reported that no existing subcategory described the failure, one choosing action_version and one matrix_or_trigger while calling it a poor fit. build_step_misconfig was added to the taxonomy for this and the label moved to it. Both noted the meson stderr is not in the captured log, so the shallow checkout explanation is inference. Maintainer confirmed pipeline_config and chose build_step_misconfig over the two existing values the labellers reached for, on the grounds that the automatic builder cannot build this project.
